children: Sushil Patel, Chief Executive Officer and director, sold 49,026 shares of Replimune Group, Inc. common stock on November 16, 2026, at a weighted average price of $21.60 per share for a total of $1,058,962. The shares were sold to cover tax withholding obligations upon the vesting of restricted stock units under an irrevocable sell-to-cover provision and were not a discretionary sale. Patel directly owns 659,125 shares following the transaction.
